parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic. It is a curved top part that covers the opening of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: The lid prevents odors from escaping and keeps the trash concealed. It can be lifted or flipped open to dispose of waste.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or flip open around a hinge or pivot point to allow access to the trashcan interior.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic. It is a tall, rectangular container that holds the waste.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the main compartment for collecting and storing trash. It supports the lid and provides structural stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during normal use but can be lifted or moved when emptying or cleaning.
